enabled.description: Enable or disable the ipband daemon at startup.

logfile.description: Path to the log file. Leave empty to disable file logging.

loglevel.description: Minimum log level — only messages at or above this level are logged.

retained_snapshots.description: Number of snapshots to keep in memory (for trend analysis and reports).

interfaces.description: List of network interfaces to monitor. Use 'any' to monitor all non-loopback interfaces.

monitored_subnets.description: List of subnets (CIDR notation) to monitor. If empty, all traffic is captured.

excluded_subnets.description: List of subnets to exclude from monitoring (CIDR notation).

email_enabled.description: Enable sending email reports (requires valid SMTP configuration).

report_recipients.description: Email addresses that receive bandwidth reports.

report_sender.description: Sender email address used for reports.

smtp_host.description: SMTP server hostname or IP address.

smtp_port.description: SMTP server port (typically 587 for STARTTLS, 465 for SSL, or 25).

smtp_starttls.description: Use STARTTLS encryption for SMTP connections.

smtp_username.description: SMTP username (only used if smtp_auth is enabled).

smtp_password.description: SMTP password (only used if smtp_auth is enabled).

report_frequency.description: Report frequency: 'daily', 'weekly', or integer seconds for custom intervals.

include_interface_breakdown.description: Include per-interface bandwidth breakdown in reports.

bandwidth_alert_threshold.description: Bandwidth threshold (in MB/s) that triggers an alert if exceeded.

bandwidth_alert_duration.description: Duration (seconds) the threshold must be exceeded before an alert is sent.

alert_recipients.description: Email addresses that receive alerts. Falls back to report_recipients if empty.

alert_throttle.description: Enable throttling to prevent alert flooding.

alert_throttle_interval.description: Minimum seconds between alerts for the same condition (only effective if alert_throttle is true).
